hunt.justification: The Klue supply chain attack demonstrated that dormant or prototype OAuth integrations can provide a persistent back-door into sensitive CRM data. Detecting this requires correlating specific integration names with OAuth refresh token behaviors that bypass standard MFA triggers.

series.title: Detecting the Klue supply chain attack in Salesforce

related.reason: This hunt focuses on the authentication phase; the subsequent high-volume API querying and paging behavior are handled in the exfiltration-focused hunt.

meta.analysis: Standard rules detect 'unseen network' logins, but they lack the application-specific context (Klue Battlecards) and the behavioral correlation with specific Python-based API discovery traffic. This hunt pivots between SaaS authentication and HTTP activity to provide a higher-fidelity signal of token abuse.

coverage.reason: The compromise occurred at the vendor (Klue); this hunt focuses on the effects within the customer environment.

stages.name: Third-party Integration Compromise

stages.name: CRM Object Discovery via REST API

scenario.summary: A threat actor (Icarus) compromised a third-party vendor (Klue) to obtain legitimate OAuth tokens, which were then used to authenticate to victim Salesforce environments. The actor used automated Python scripts to perform large-scale harvesting of CRM objects like Opportunities and Contacts via the Salesforce REST API for extortion purposes.

meta.rationale: Focus specifically on the 'Klue Battlecards' application identifier. If multiple Salesforce instances are integrated, ensure the scoping query captures all of them by broadening the 'LIKE' filter if needed.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is using compromised OAuth refresh tokens from the Klue supply chain attack to maintain persistent access to Salesforce environments from non-standard infrastructure.

actor_ips.description: Known malicious IP addresses associated with the 'Icarus' group.

blind_spots.risk: If the 'OAuth Refresh Token' sub-type is not mapped to the auth_protocol column, behavioral leads will be missed.
blind_spots.question: Are all OAuth sub-types being correctly parsed and reported by the connector?
blind_spots.requires: Complete Salesforce Event Log ingestion into hb_auth_signin and hb_http_activity

blind_spots.risk: The corroborate-api-traffic step relies on temporal proximity; if logs are lost, the link between auth and exfiltration is weakened.
blind_spots.question: Was the automated activity conducted from a short-lived VPS that has since rotated?
blind_spots.requires: Longer retention of HTTP user agent data

hunt.name: Anomalous SaaS Authentication: Klue Salesforce Compromise
hunt.description: This hunt identifies anomalous authentication activity related to the Klue supply chain compromise. It specifically looks for 'Klue Battlecards' integration activity using OAuth refresh tokens, correlates these events with known malicious IP addresses, and baselines source IP prevalence to find outliers. The hunt then corroborates these logins with subsequent REST API activity to confirm automated exfiltration behavior.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_name, provider, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (LOWER(dst_endpoint_name) LIKE '%klue%' OR LOWER(metadata_product) LIKE '%klue%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find all users and IPs interacting with the Salesforce environment via the Klue integration.
config.expected_signal: A list of users and source IPs using the Klue integration. An empty result suggests the integration is not present or has not been active in the window.

primitive_config.label: Identify Klue Battlecards authentication events
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_name, provider, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (LOWER(dst_endpoint_name) LIKE '%klue%' OR LOWER(metadata_product) LIKE '%klue%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A list of users and source IPs using the Klue integration. An empty result suggests the integration is not present or has not been active in the window.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_name, auth_protocol, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE instr(',' || '{{actor_ips}}' || ',', ',' || src_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Directly match the report's indicators against SaaS authentication logs.
config.expected_signal: Any match is a high-confidence indicator of compromise. Zero results do not mean safety, as IP rotation is expected.

primitive_config.label: Authentication from known malicious IPs
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_name, auth_protocol, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE instr(',' || '{{actor_ips}}' || ',', ',' || src_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Any match is a high-confidence indicator of compromise. Zero results do not mean safety, as IP rotation is expected.

nodes.label: Rare source IPs for Klue integration

config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_name, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) AS unique_users, COUNT(*) AS auth_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (LOWER(dst_endpoint_name) LIKE '%klue%' OR LOWER(metadata_product) LIKE '%klue%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_name HAVING unique_users <= 2 ORDER BY auth_count ASC
config.description: Stack-count IPs per user for the Klue application to find anomalous access locations.
config.expected_signal: Source IPs used by only 1 or 2 users for this specific app. This highlights potential attacker infrastructure bypassing typical corporate VPNs.

primitive_config.label: Rare source IPs for Klue integration
primitive_config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_name, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) AS unique_users, COUNT(*) AS auth_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (LOWER(dst_endpoint_name) LIKE '%klue%' OR LOWER(metadata_product) LIKE '%klue%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_name HAVING unique_users <= 2 ORDER BY auth_count ASC

nodes.label: OAuth Refresh Token usage in auth logs

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, auth_protocol, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (LOWER(dst_endpoint_name) LIKE '%klue%' OR LOWER(metadata_product) LIKE '%klue%') AND (LOWER(auth_protocol) LIKE '%refresh%' OR LOWER(activity_name) LIKE '%refresh%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify logins explicitly using the OAuth Refresh Token subtype as mentioned in the report.
config.expected_signal: Authentication events specifically utilizing refresh tokens. This is the durable behavioral lead mentioned for this compromise.

primitive_config.label: OAuth Refresh Token usage in auth logs
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, auth_protocol, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (LOWER(dst_endpoint_name) LIKE '%klue%' OR LOWER(metadata_product) LIKE '%klue%') AND (LOWER(auth_protocol) LIKE '%refresh%' OR LOWER(activity_name) LIKE '%refresh%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Authentication events specifically utilizing refresh tokens. This is the durable behavioral lead mentioned for this compromise.

config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, url_path, user_agent, status_code, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE url_path LIKE '/services/data/%/query%' AND (user_agent LIKE 'Python-urllib/%' OR user_agent = '5238') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Verify if IPs identified in auth logs are also performing automated REST API queries against Salesforce endpoints.
config.expected_signal: HTTP requests to the vulnerable query endpoint from suspicious user agents. Matches between this and the auth step confirm post-auth automated discovery.

primitive_config.label: Corroborate with automated API activity
primitive_config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, url_path, user_agent, status_code, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE url_path LIKE '/services/data/%/query%' AND (user_agent LIKE 'Python-urllib/%' OR user_agent = '5238') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: HTTP requests to the vulnerable query endpoint from suspicious user agents. Matches between this and the auth step confirm post-auth automated discovery.

config.objective: Determine if the Klue integration has been abused by comparing rare authentication IPs, OAuth refresh token usage, and API-heavy HTTP traffic from the same sources.
config.description: Consolidate authentication anomalies with subsequent HTTP behavior to provide a verdict on token abuse.
config.expected_signal: A host-by-host or IP-by-IP verdict identifying confirmed malicious activity.
config.success_criteria: A per-IP verdict of malicious, suspicious, or benign with citations for auth protocols and HTTP user agents.
